title: Recording of hearing.
bodyHtml:
[§658J-14]  Recording of hearing.  (a)  Except as provided in subsection (b) an arbitration hearing need not be recorded unless:

     (1)  Otherwise required by law of this State other than this chapter;

     (2)  Required by the arbitrator;

     (3)  Provided by the arbitration agreement; or

     (4)  Requested by a party.

     (b)  An arbitrator shall require a verbatim recording be made of any part of an arbitration hearing concerning a child-related dispute. [L 2017, c 113, pt of §1]
